summary: Sirach 25-43 had most declarative sayings unitemized (new records, plus extensions where motive clauses trail existing records); Sirach 44-51 yields mainly parallels to Torah priestly laws and commissions; Isaiah 1-11 lacks its woes, the 2:5 summons, the 7:14 naming and the 10:5-6 commission.
